#### Welcome!

I'm a postdoctoral researcher at the French National Institute for Demographic Studies (Ined) within the [SOC-MISC project](https://soc-misc.site.ined.fr/). I work on miscarriage, assisted reproduction, infertility and (late) fertility. Previously, I worked at the University of Vienna, where I participated in the [BIC.Late project](https://biclate.univie.ac.at/).

## Research experience

**Postdoctoral researcher**, French National Institute for Demographic Studies (Ined) \| July. 2024 - present

**Postdoctoral researcher**, University of Vienna - Wittgenstein Centre \| June 2021 - Sept. 2024

**Ph.D. Candidate**, French National Institute for Demographic Studies (Ined) \| Sept. 2017 - June 2021

## Education

**Ph.D. in Demography**, Paris I Panthéon-Sorbonne University/ Ined \| Sept. 2017 - June 2021
